recommendedPapers.title: Efficient Transformer Self-Attention
recommendedPapers.abstract: We propose an efficient self-attention mechanism reducing complexity from O(n^2) to O(n log n).

recommendedPapers.title: Mixture of Experts Scaling Laws
recommendedPapers.abstract: Empirical scaling laws for mixture-of-experts language models across compute budgets.

recommendedPapers.title: State Space Models vs Transformers
recommendedPapers.abstract: Comparative study of SSMs and transformers on long-context language modeling tasks.

tldr.text: SSMs match transformers on long sequences with lower memory.

recommendedPapers.title: In-Context Learning via Meta-Learning
recommendedPapers.abstract: A meta-learning perspective on in-context learning in large language models.

recommendedPapers.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
recommendedPapers.abstract: Training AI systems to be helpful, harmless, and honest using AI-generated feedback.

tldr.text: Constitutional AI uses AI self-critique for alignment.

recommendedPapers.title: Speculative Decoding for Fast Inference
recommendedPapers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting tokens with a smaller model.

recommendedPapers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning
recommendedPapers.abstract: Generating a chain of thought — a series of intermediate reasoning steps — improves LLM reasoning.

tldr.text: CoT prompting improves complex reasoning in LLMs.

recommendedPapers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Open-Domain QA
recommendedPapers.abstract: RAG combines non-parametric retrieval with parametric generation for knowledge-intensive NLP tasks.

recommendedPapers.title: Flash Attention: Fast Memory-Efficient Attention
recommendedPapers.abstract: IO-aware exact attention algorithm that reduces memory usage and speeds up training.

tldr.text: Flash Attention uses tiling to minimize HBM reads/writes.

recommendedPapers.title: Reward Model Ensembles for RLHF
recommendedPapers.abstract: Using ensembles of reward models to reduce variance and improve robustness in RLHF pipelines.
